## Why This Topic Matters

A statistical model is a structured approximation that links observed data to an estimand or prediction target.

## Learning Objectives

After working through this material, you should be able to:

- explain the main ideas behind **Variable selection**;
- interpret the R workflow and its output; and
- adapt the examples to a related analysis.

## Lesson Roadmap

The original material is organized around the following topics:

1. Variable selection
2. Stepwise regression
3. Ridge regression
4. Lasso regression
5. Elastic net
6. Machine learning approch

## How to Use This Lesson

Read the explanation before each workflow, then run the R chunks in sequence. Code and output are shown together so that each numerical or graphical result can be connected to the command that produced it. Some source examples require optional packages or external data. - k-fold cross-validation for backward direction

(10 fold, repeated 3 times; take the average of all the individual  scores; then train the model on the entire initial training data set with [the specific hyper-parameter value](https://medium.com/analytics-vidhya/regularization-and-cross-validation-how-to-choose-the-penalty-value-lambda-1217fa4351e5)) 



The main thing to remember here is that we have to keep the test data away from the algorithm and do all the validation only on the training data.

![](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/_images/grid_search_workflow.png)

Three scenarios: 

  - Collect another completely independent dataset and test your model. 

  - If you have a sufficiently large dataset, you would then build your model on the remaining training samples and then test on these left-out samples.Usually splits the dataset into a large training set and a smaller test set (= holdout) and perform the k-fold CV on the training set, then validates on the test set.

![](https://miro.medium.com/v2/resize:fit:1100/format:webp/1*kqVo1EWX-crwgqGiv-yXjA.png)

  - If you have a smaller dataset, the validation is performed on every fold (k-fold CV).

Caret cv
